name: Redirect Purchase to Chat for Woo
author: Mutt Group / Mutt Studio

sections.description:
Redirect Purchase to Chat for Woo lets you replace the standard “Buy Now” WooCommerce button with a customizable link that sends users directly to a chat (like WhatsApp).
Perfect for stores that prefer to finalize sales via messaging, allowing personal interaction before closing a deal.

Features:

  • Redirect the “Buy Now” button to a custom chat URL or phone number.
  • Supports platforms like WhatsApp, Telegram, or any URL with pre-filled parameters.
  • Opens the chat in a new tab on both product and archive pages.
  • Customize the button label and the default message.
  • Simple admin settings within the WooCommerce menu.
  • Multi-language support: English and Portuguese (pt_BR).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Compra para Chat to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It redirects the “Buy Now” button in WooCommerce product pages to a custom chat link with a pre-filled message, allowing customers to start a conversation (e.g., on WhatsApp) before completing the purchase.

Can I customize the message and the button text?

Yes, you can define the WhatsApp number, message template, and button label in the plugin settings.

Will this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Can I use it with Telegram or other platforms?

Yes. As long as the platform supports chat initiation via URL, you can insert a custom URL in the settings.
